requirements: Lead with free AI services and free AI APIs: no credit card, generous free tier, usable today.
Every suggestion must name the free service, its real limits, and one concrete way to earn with it.
Prefer easy money: something the owner can start in under 2 hours with no upfront spend.
Prefer repeatable offers over one-off tasks, and same-week payout over deferred upside.
State the earning path in plain language: who pays, for what, and roughly how much.
Skip anything needing paid infrastructure, approval queues, or an audience the owner lacks.
Do not count discovery or speculative upside as earnings.

reference_sources.title: OpenRouter free model list
reference_sources.takeaway: Live list of zero-cost models usable through a single API key. Free (:free) models are capped at 20 req/min and only 50 req/day unless the account has ever purchased $10 in credits (then 1,000/day) -- verify current limit before relying on volume.

reference_sources.title: Google AI Studio (Gemini API)
reference_sources.takeaway: No credit card required. Gemini 2.5 Flash free tier is roughly 1,500 requests/day (10 RPM, 250K TPM); Gemini 2.0 Flash is roughly 15 RPM / 1M TPM. Much higher daily ceiling than OpenRouter's free chain -- verify current limit.

reference_sources.title: Cerebras Cloud free tier
reference_sources.takeaway: No credit card required. Roughly 1M tokens/day and 14,400 requests/day per model on fast inference hardware. Strong fallback once OpenRouter's free daily cap is hit -- verify current limit.

reference_sources.title: Groq Cloud free tier
reference_sources.takeaway: No credit card required. Generous daily request allowance (roughly 14K/day depending on model) with very low latency -- verify current limit.

outreach.fallback_payment_note: Payment address is configured privately; add it manually before sending.

llm.note: All-free model chain, ordered per role in bot/llm.py _OPENROUTER_MODELS_BY_ROLE. openrouter/free -- the free auto-router -- leads every chain: it picks the best zero-cost model per request and filters for the features the request needs, so model choice tracks the live catalogue. openrouter/auto is deliberately NOT used: its candidate set includes paid models and it bills at the routed model's rate. Named free models (led by minimax/minimax-m3:free, 1M ctx, native response_format + tools) follow as fallback for when the router is rate-limited; on 402/429/404 the client steps down the rest of the role's free chain before changing provider.

evolution.note: LLM code proposals are committed to a review branch (branch_prefix/<version>-<utc>) and never to main. Merge the branch to apply. Writes are restricted to bot/, docs/, config/, requirements.txt, version.txt; bot/main.py, bot/llm.py, bot/status.py, bot/commands.py, bot/evolution.py, bot/git_utils.py and .github/ can never be written. Engine is the free OpenRouter 'upgrade' chain led by the openrouter/free auto-router; no paid model.
